subject.title: fix(agents): reject execCommand's promise on AbortSignal cancellation

question: Should `ExtensionContext.exec()` standardize caller AbortSignal cancellation as rejection despite the behavioral change for extensions that previously consumed a resolved killed result?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and matches sibling session tools, but this is a documented public plugin API behavior change whose upgrade trade-off requires owner intent.

options.title: Adopt documented rejection semantics
options.body: Accept rejection as the canonical caller-cancellation contract and merge this narrowly tested implementation.

options.title: Retain the historical result shape
options.body: Keep caller cancellation resolving with a killed result and pursue any future API change through an explicit compatibility path.

recommendation.title: Adopt documented rejection semantics
recommendation.body: Accept rejection as the canonical caller-cancellation contract and merge this narrowly tested implementation.
